dedupe_keys.name: industrial process and waste heat data for eu28 process heat and waste heat temperatures and quantities in paper chemical refinery and food sectors

description: A collation of process-level heat data for European industry, built to size the market for industrial heat pumps up to 200 °C. The Mendeley Data record says it gives process heat demand and waste heat temperatures and quantities for processes in the paper, chemical, refinery and food sectors, focusing on residual streams where heat pumps could be integrated: the hot utility for process heat and streams discarded to ambient or a cold utility for waste heat. For chemical and refinery processes the amounts come only from distillation column reboilers and condensers, drawn anonymously from an engineering company's pinch studies database; other processes use operating plant flowsheets and literature, with sources in a references sheet. It was published on 25 November 2020 as a free downloadable dataset under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the EU28 by process type, not by site. Caveats: anonymised typical processes, and the file format and number of processes are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives the temperature levels and heat quantities needed to model electrification of industrial heat and the recovery of waste heat into district heating. Related catalogue records include the Hotmaps industrial sites excess heat data and the sEEnergies open data hub.
